title: Direct IT/OT Communication risk at SCADA Server with Office Workstation
plain_title: Direct IT/OT Communication risk at SCADA Server with Office Workstation
references: IEC 62443-3-3 SR 5.1 Network Segmentation
IEC 62443-3-3 SR 5.2 Zone Boundary Protection
MITRE ATT&CK for ICS T0883 Internet Accessible Device
MITRE ATT&CK for ICS T0886 Remote Services
NIST SP 800-82r3 Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
mitigation: Separate IT and OT with an industrial DMZ, so that no communication link crosses from IT into a control zone directly: replicate the historian into the DMZ for IT users, give remote and vendor access only through a jump host there, and filter what passes with firewalls on both sides. Tag the assets in the DMZ with industrial-dmz.
check: Are the recommendations of NIST SP 800-82 and the referenced IEC 62443 requirements applied?

title: Insecure Control Protocol risk at Chlorine Safety Controller over modbus from SCADA Server
plain_title: Insecure Control Protocol risk at Chlorine Safety Controller over modbus from SCADA Server
references: IEC 62443-3-3 SR 1.2 Software Process and Device Identification and Authentication
IEC 62443-3-3 SR 3.1 Communication Integrity
MITRE ATT&CK for ICS T0855 Unauthorized Command Message
MITRE ATT&CK for ICS T0830 Adversary-in-the-Middle
NIST SP 800-82r3 Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
mitigation: Use the secure variant of the protocol where the devices support it (Modbus/TCP Security, DNP3 over TLS or with Secure Authentication, CIP Security, OPC UA with SignAndEncrypt, S7comm-plus with access protection), and enable the access protection of the controllers. Where the protocol cannot be secured, allow only the expected senders and function codes with an industrial firewall in front of the controller, and keep controllers in RUN mode with the key switch.
check: Are the recommendations of NIST SP 800-82 and the referenced IEC 62443 requirements applied?

title: Long-Lived Credentials risk at Engineering Workstation used by Jump Host (credentials)
plain_title: Long-Lived Credentials risk at Engineering Workstation used by Jump Host (credentials)
references: OWASP NHI7:2025 Long-Lived Secrets
OWASP NHI2:2025 Secret Leakage
mitigation: Replace static secrets between services with a workload identity issued by the platform (cloud IAM roles, Kubernetes service account tokens, SPIFFE), or with short-lived tokens obtained through OAuth 2.0 client credentials or token exchange, and model the link with the identity workload or the authentication short-lived-token. Where a long-lived secret remains, keep it in a vault, scope it narrowly, rotate it automatically and detect its use from unexpected places.

title: Missing Safety System Independence risk at Chlorine Safety Controller changed by Engineering Workstation
plain_title: Missing Safety System Independence risk at Chlorine Safety Controller changed by Engineering Workstation
references: IEC 61511 Independence of the Safety Instrumented System
MITRE ATT&CK for ICS T0880 Loss of Safety
MITRE ATT&CK for ICS T0843 Program Download
IEC 62443-3-3 SR 5.1 Network Segmentation
NIST SP 800-82r3 Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
mitigation: Let only a dedicated safety engineering workstation, which programs no other controllers, change the safety controller, and give the basic process control and the HMIs readonly access to its status. Keep the key switch of the safety controller in RUN mode outside of maintenance, and alert on every program change.
